      pathCoverNumber G U + (ineligibleSet G U).card ∧
    (∀ X, X ⊆ U →
      componentCount G (U \ X) = pathCoverNumber G U + X.card →
        X ⊆ ineligibleSet G U) ∧
    (∀ X, X ⊆ U →

        X.card ≤ (ineligibleSet G U).card)

      componentCount G (U \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G U ∧
      ∃ C : (G.induce ((U \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
        ∀ y ∈ (ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S,
          ∃ hy : y ∈ U \ S,
            (G.induce ((U \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
              ⟨y, hy⟩ = C

statement:
lemma profile_scattering_maximum {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A)) (hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty) :
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) ≤
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    ((componentCount G (U \ profileContainer (G := G) U A) : ℤ) -
      ((profileContainer (G := G) U A).card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T ⊆ profileContainer (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T.card ≤ (profileContainer (G := G) U A).card)

    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) ≤
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    ((componentCount G (U \ profileContainer (G := G) U A) : ℤ) -
      ((profileContainer (G := G) U A).card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T ⊆ profileContainer (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →

statement:
lemma cycle_leftover_cover_min_of_saturated {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) = c.walk.edges.toFinset ∧
          pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) ∧
            pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p ∧
              ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complement_arc_of_mem_leftover
statement:
lemma exists_complement_arc_of_mem_leftover {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    {p : GraphPath G} {pc : PathCover G (U \ A)} {Q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hpaths : pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p) (hQ : Q ∈ pc.paths) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = U \ Q.support ∧
        r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ A ∧
          G.Adj r.finish Q.start ∧ G.Adj Q.finish r.start

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_cycle_leftover_cover

lemma exists_cycle_leftover_cover {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) = c.walk.edges.toFinset ∧
          pc.card ≤ A.card ∧
            pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p ∧
              ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_complement_of_leftover_edges

lemma exists_complement_of_leftover_edges {A : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = p.support \ Q.support ∧
        r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ A ∧
          G.Adj r.finish Q.start ∧ G.Adj Q.finish r.start ∧
            r.edges ⊆ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} ∧
              s(r.finish, Q.start) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} ∧
                s(Q.finish, r.start) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complete_join_of_saving
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_of_saving {U0 : Finset V}
    (hU0 : IsCograph G U0)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ U0.card) :
    ∃ X Y : Finset V, X ⊆ U0 ∧ Y ⊆ U0 ∧ X.Nonempty ∧ Y.Nonempty ∧
      Disjoint X Y ∧ X ∪ Y = U0 ∧
        G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V) ∧
          X.card < U0.card ∧ Y.card < U0.card

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_saving_component
statement:
lemma exists_saving_component {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) < A.card)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hf : p.finish ∉ A) (hno : NoConsecutive A p) :
    ∃ (U0 : Finset V) (pcU0 : PathCover G U0),
      U0 ⊆ U \ A ∧ U0.Nonempty ∧
        (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected ∧
          IsCograph G U0 ∧
            (∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
              pcU0.paths =
                List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p) ∧
                2 ≤ pcU0.card ∧
                  pathCoverNumber G U0 < pcU0.card ∧
                    2 ≤ U0.card ∧
                      ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_saving_of_cover
statement:
lemma exists_saving_of_cover {W : Finset V} (hne : W.Nonempty)
    (pc : PathCover G W) (hp : pathCoverNumber G W < pc.card) :
    ∃ U0 : Finset V,
      U0 ⊆ W ∧ U0.Nonempty ∧
        (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected ∧
          (∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
            2 ≤ leftoverCountIn pc U0 ∧
              pathCoverNumber G U0 < leftoverCountIn pc U0 ∧
                ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_ends
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_ends {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.finish ≠ R.finish) (hadj : G.Adj Q.finish R.finish) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish

statement:
theorem protected_exact_of_rotate {p : GraphPath G} {a x : V}
    (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {A : Finset V}
    (hsup : p.support = c.support) (hA : A ⊆ p.support)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A ∧
      (F.rotate hyx).start = a ∧
        (F.rotate hyx).start ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish ∧
          (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges a = p.incidentEdges a \ {s(a, x)} ∧
            (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ a →
              (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b) ∧
              (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ a → b ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish →
                (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges b = c.incidentEdges b) ∧
                ((F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges a).card = 1 ∧
                  (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges a ⊆ c.edges

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.protected_exact_of_insertBlock
statement:
theorem protected_exact_of_insertBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)
    (q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {A : Finset V}
    (hsup : (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).support = c.support)
    (hA : A ⊆ (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).support)
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAq : Disjoint q.support A)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).ProtectedAt c A ∧
      (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).start = p.start ∧
        (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).finish = p.finish ∧
          (∀ b ∈ A,
            (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b) ∧
            (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ p.start → b ≠ p.finish →
              (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b =
                c.incidentEdges b) ∧
              (p.start ∈ A →
                ((F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.start).card = 1 ∧
                  (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.start ⊆
                    c.edges) ∧
                (p.finish ∈ A →
                  ((F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.finish).card = 1 ∧
                    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.finish ⊆
                      c.edges)

Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_insertBlock_of_index
statement:
theorem exists_insertBlock_of_index (p : GraphPath G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < p.walk.length) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj (p.walk.getVert i) q.start)
    (hf : G.Adj q.finish (p.walk.getVert (i + 1))) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = p.start ∧
        r.finish = p.finish ∧
          r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∧
            r.edges =
              p.edges.erase s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∪
                q.edges ∪
                  {s(p.walk.getVert i, q.start),
                    s(q.finish, p.walk.getVert (i + 1))}

    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = p.start ∧
        r.finish = p.finish ∧
          r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∧
            r.edges =

    {c : GraphCycle G} {A : Finset V}
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAQ : Disjoint Q.support A)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.protected_exact_of_insertOmittedBlock
statement:
theorem protected_exact_of_insertOmittedBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor r u v)
    (Q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint Q.support r.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u Q.start) (hf : G.Adj Q.finish v)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {A : Finset V}
    (hsup : (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).support = c.support)
    (hA : A ⊆ (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).support)
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAQ : Disjoint Q.support A)
    (hP : r.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).ProtectedAt c A ∧
      (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).start = r.start ∧
        (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).finish = r.finish ∧
          (∀ b ∈ A,
            (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b =
              r.incidentEdges b) ∧
            (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ r.start → b ≠ r.finish →
              (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b =
                c.incidentEdges b)

statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XX_of_saving {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}

    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)

lemma exists_spliceAcc (acc : GraphPath G) (rest : List (GraphPath G))
    (hdisj : ∀ q ∈ rest, Disjoint acc.support q.support)

    (hfirst : ∀ (hne : rest ≠ []),
      G.Adj acc.finish (rest.head hne).start)
    (htail : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < rest.length),
      G.Adj (rest.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish

    ∃ r : GraphPath G,

theorem noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G) {v : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support) (hv : v ∈ r.support)
    (hAne : (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty)
    (hJ : ∀ ⦃a b c' d x : V⦄,
      a ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
        b ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
          c' ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
            d ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
              x ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
      InducedP4 G a b c' d →
      x ≠ a → x ≠ b → x ≠ c' → x ≠ d →
        G.Adj x a ∨ G.Adj x b ∨ G.Adj x c' ∨ G.Adj x d) :
    NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v) ↔
      pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support v) <
        (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).card

name: Nikoghosyan.pair_profile_dichotomy
statement:
theorem pair_profile_dichotomy
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support) :
    (∀ v ∈ cD.support,
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
          IsCograph G
              (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
            pathCoverNumber G
                (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card) ∨
      ∃ S : Finset V,
        Cograph.Tight (G := G) cH.support S ∧
          S ⊂ cH.support ∧
            (∀ v ∈ cD.support,
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
                IsCograph G
                    (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
                  Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
                    (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
                    Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) = S ∧
                      rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v ⊆ S) ∧
              (∀ x ∈ cH.support, ∀ y ∈ cD.support, G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)

name: Nikoghosyan.pair_profile_dichotomy_of_min
statement:
theorem pair_profile_dichotomy_of_min (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
          IsCograph G
              ((F.getCycle i).support \
                rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
            pathCoverNumber G
                ((F.getCycle i).support \
                  rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) <
              (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).card) ∨
      ∃ S : Finset V,
        Cograph.Tight (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support S ∧
          S ⊂ (F.getCycle i).support ∧
            (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
              (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
                IsCograph G
                    ((F.getCycle i).support \
                      rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                  Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
                    (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                    Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G)
                        (F.getCycle i).support
                        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) =
                      S ∧
                      rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v ⊆ S) ∧
              (∀ x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support, ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
                G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.returnRotate_of_completeJoin
statement:
theorem returnRotate_of_completeJoin (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    {U0 A X Y : Finset V}
    (hyY : p.start ∈ Y) (hxX : x ∈ X)
    (hjoin : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ X, G.Adj y z)
    (haU : a ∉ U0) (hxU : x ∈ U0) (hyU : p.start ∈ U0)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    {c : GraphCycle G} (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    let hyx := hjoin p.start hyY x hxX
    (F.rotate hyx).start = a ∧
      (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish ∧
        (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support ∧
          (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A ∧
            (F.rotate hyx).boundaryEdges U0 =
              (p.boundaryEdges U0).erase s(a, x)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.returnRotate_spec
statement:
theorem returnRotate_spec (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    {U0 A : Finset V} (hyx : G.Adj p.start x)
    (haU : a ∉ U0) (hxU : x ∈ U0) (hyU : p.start ∈ U0)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    {c : GraphCycle G} (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.rotate hyx).start = a ∧
      (F.rotate hyx).start ∈ A ∧
        (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish ∧
          (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support ∧
            (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A ∧
              (F.rotate hyx).boundaryEdges U0 =
                (p.boundaryEdges U0).erase s(a, x) ∧
                s(p.start, x) ∈ (F.rotate hyx).edges ∧
                  ¬ endsStraddle s(p.start, x) U0

theorem exists_enteringFactor (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hs : p.start ∈ U0) (h2 : 2 ≤ (p.boundaryEdges U0).card) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p (p.walk.getVert i) (p.walk.getVert (i + 1))),
      i < p.walk.length ∧

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_returnRotate
statement:
theorem exists_returnRotate (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hs : p.start ∈ U0) (h2 : 2 ≤ (p.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {A X Y : Finset V} {c : GraphCycle G}
    (hjoin : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ X, G.Adj y z)
    (hyY : p.start ∈ Y)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A)
    (hAout : Disjoint A U0)
    (hYU : Y ⊆ U0) (hXU : X ⊆ U0)
    (henterX : ∀ i, i < p.walk.length → p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 →
      p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 → p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X)
    (henterA : ∀ i, i < p.walk.length → p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 →
      p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 → p.walk.getVert i ∈ A) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p (p.walk.getVert i) (p.walk.getVert (i + 1)))
      (hyx : G.Adj p.start (p.walk.getVert (i + 1))),
      i < p.walk.length ∧
        p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧
          p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 ∧
            p.walk.getVert i ∈ A ∧
              p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X ∧
                (F.rotate hyx).start = p.walk.getVert i ∧
                  (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support ∧
                    (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A

lemma exists_min_terminalCover_complete_join {X Y B : Finset V}

    (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hdom : Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X)
    (hX : ∃ pc : PathCover G X,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G X ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (X ∪ Y),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc

    (hA : ∃ pc : PathCover G A,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc)
    (hC : ∃ pc : PathCover G C,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G C ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (A ∪ C),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ C) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc

    (hmin : ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :

name: Nikoghosyan.q_max_mem_interval_of_sides
statement:
lemma q_max_mem_interval_of_sides (P : AllCographSides G)
    (htough : OneTough G)
    (hmin : ∃ pc : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pc) :
    let q := max (pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) (P.m - P.U.card)
    pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ q ∧
      q + pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.B.card

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_eq_two_mul
statement:

    delta G S T =
      2 * ((S.card : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) + (internalEdgeCount G T : ℤ) +

            componentAttach G S T c / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_neg_iff_le_neg_two

theorem delta_neg_iff_le_neg_two {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_componentVerts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_componentVerts_iff {S T : Finset V}
    {c : (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent} {v : V} :
    v ∈ componentVerts G S T c ↔
      ∃ hv : v ∈ ((S ∪ T : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ,
        (Remain G S T).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩ = c

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_remainderVerts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_remainderVerts_iff {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :

statement:
lemma mem_remainderVerts_iff' {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.natCast_sum_attach_decompose
statement:
lemma natCast_sum_attach_decompose (S T : Finset V) :
    ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G S T c : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      2 * ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
              componentAttach G S T c / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) +
        (hCount G S T : ℤ)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.natCast_sum_degDelete
statement:

      2 * (internalEdgeCount G T : ℤ) +
        ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighbor_sdiff_eq_union
statement:
lemma neighbor_sdiff_eq_union {S T : Finset V} {t : V}

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_biUnion
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_biUnion {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Finset V) (B : Finset V)
    (hd : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) :
    orderedEdgeCount G (s.biUnion f) B =
      ∑ i ∈ s, orderedEdgeCount G (f i) B

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_eq_compl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_componentAttach_decompose
statement:

    ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G S T c =
      2 * ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_degDelete
statement:
lemma sum_degDelete {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    ∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t =

        orderedEdgeCount G (remainderVerts G S T) T

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_degDelete_eq_internal_add_attach
statement:
theorem sum_degDelete_eq_internal_add_attach {S T : Finset V}
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    ∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t =

        ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),

    ∃ t1 t2 t3 d1 d2 d3,
      t1 ∈ B.T ∧ t2 ∈ B.T ∧ t3 ∈ B.T ∧
      t1 ≠ t2 ∧ t1 ≠ t3 ∧ t2 ≠ t3 ∧
      d1 ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c ∧
      d2 ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c ∧
      d3 ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c ∧
      d1 ≠ d2 ∧ d1 ≠ d3 ∧ d2 ≠ d3 ∧
      G.Adj t1 d1 ∧ G.Adj t2 d2 ∧ G.Adj t3 d3

        - (orderedEdgeCount G T {x} : ℤ)

statement:

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_bichromatic_component_of_cycle
statement:
theorem exists_bichromatic_component_of_cycle (c : EdgeColoring G C) {v : V}
    (w : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : w.IsCycle)
    (hcol : c.dartColor (w.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
      c.dartColor (w.lastDart hcyc.not_nil)) :
    ∃ (x y : {z : V // z ≠ v}) (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1),
      (deleteGraph G v).Reachable x y ∧ c.color hx ≠ c.color hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_cycle_of_bichromatic_component
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_bichromatic_component (c : EdgeColoring G C) (v : V)
    (x y : {w : V // w ≠ v}) (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1)
    (hreach : (deleteGraph G v).Reachable x y)
    (hcol : c.color hx ≠ c.color hy) :
    ∃ (w : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : w.IsCycle),
      c.dartColor (w.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) = c.color hx ∧
      c.dartColor (w.lastDart hcyc.not_nil) = c.color hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.reachable_in_delete_of_cycle
statement:
theorem reachable_in_delete_of_cycle {v : V} {w : G.Walk v v}
    (hcyc : w.IsCycle) :
    ∃ (x y : {z : V // z ≠ v}),
      G.Adj v x.1 ∧ G.Adj v y.1 ∧
        x.1 = w.snd ∧ y.1 = w.penultimate ∧
          (deleteGraph G v).Reachable x y
